column3: Close to the Hebrew; “impurity” is rendered “uncleanness.”
Close to the Hebrew; “a cloak of hair” is rendered “a robe of coarse hair.”
NKJV renders “a man acquired (sold) me from my youth” as “a man taught me to keep cattle from my youth.”
Close to the Hebrew; “between your hands” is rendered “between your arms.”
Close to the Hebrew; “my shepherd … the man of my fellowship” is rendered “My Shepherd … the Man who is My Companion,” capitalized.
Close to the Hebrew; “a mouth of two” is rendered “two-thirds.”
